modifications: Entries were selected, normalised (HTML removed, years parsed, headline titles shortened to about 100 characters with an ellipsis), merged and de-duplicated across sources, ranked, capped per day and category, and sorted. Summaries keep the source wording. did_you_know facts are either Wikipedia "Did you know" hooks (text only, reformatted) or one-sentence rewordings of existing entries (prefixed with the date, possibly shortened). Image links are unmodified Wikimedia URLs.

did_you_know.fact: On November 20, 1998: The first space station module component, Zarya, for the International Space Station is launched from the Baikonur Cosmodrome in Kazakhstan.
On November 20, 1985: Microsoft Windows 1.0, the first graphical personal computer operating environment developed by Microsoft, is released.
On November 20, 2022: The 2022 FIFA World Cup begins in Qatar. This is the first time the tournament was held in the Middle East.
November 20 is observed as Teachers' Day or Ngày nhà giáo Việt Nam (Vietnam).
November 20 is observed as Transgender Day of Remembrance (LGBTQ community).
